#  13289 - Building Structures Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **13289**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Building Structures**  |  
|  Building Structures   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 6 - Architecture, Civil Engineering and Urban Planning   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. M.Sc. Eisenloffel, Karen 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  On special announcement   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | 1. Imparting the specific constructive and static knowledge of historical and modern buildings. • Knowledge of special construction and composite materials with regard to their manufacture, composition, processing, physical properties, structural joining, static properties and architectural impact, • Knowledge of complex constructions and static structures. 2. Imparting the ability to develop complex construction designs with a variety of individual requirements. • Implementation of a design concept in a constructive system using models, drawings, calculations and descriptions, • Optimization of the design in terms of material, structure, shape and manufacture, • static optimization regarding material and energy consumption  |  
| Contents:  | Seminar work with changing technical focus • interdisciplinary processing of building types or component typologies, • In-depth methodical processing of special areas, construction systems and static systems.   |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Seminar / 4 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 120 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | thematic handsets of the participating chairs  |  
| Module Examination:  | Final Module Examination (MAP)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | oral presentation (20 min)  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * Abschluss im Ausland / Architektur / keine PO 

 |  
| Remarks:  | possible cooperation with E1, E2, E3In the event that the module cannot be taught or tested according to the present description (e.g. for reasons of infection protection), the alternatives communicated on relevant platforms (e.g. homepage or Moodle) apply.  |  
| Module Components:  | 
  * 610622 Seminar BT 2 Tragwerkslehre
  * 610680 Prüfung BT 2 Tragwerkslehre

 |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
